scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run env && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backend && prettier --write frontend/src
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
